newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki slips in late reaction to markka strength.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki slips in late reaction to markka strength.

text.p: Finnish shares fell across the board on Tuesday, dragged by losses in cyclical exporters' stocks which suffered with a one-day lag from the markka's surge on Monday, brokers said.
The general HEX index closed lively 580 million markka trade one percent lower at 2,691.9 points. Some 40 percent trade was in bourse engine Nokia.
"The strong markka is clouding export companies' earnings prospects," one broker said.
The markka eased against the mark as players took profits from its record run on Monday but it did not help shares.
Nokia ended at 315.50, down 1.60 for the day but clearly below its overnight New York close as demand for telecoms was seen temporarily subdued, brokers said.

Food and chemicals group Raisio hit a new 445.00 markka record, up 40.00 markka or 10 percent in early trade, but then pared gains as overall sentiment turned sour and closed at 422.00, up 17.00. Demand was fuelled by reports of a buy recommendation from CS First Boston.
Banks and insurers fell on higher bond yields, overall losses in stocks and in a correction to recent gains.
European markets offered no support with all eyes set on Wall Street's reaction to U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony to the Senate.
"That will set the pace tomorrow," one broker said.
